narration.full_text: Let's work through an example to see how we can verify a trigonometric identity, specifically a double angle identity. This will help us practice using known ratios and algebraic manipulation. Our goal is to show that the left side of the identity is equivalent to the right side. We'll start with one side and apply various trigonometric identities and algebraic steps until it transforms into the other side. Remember, when verifying identities, it's often easiest to start with the more complex side. Watch closely as we break down each step. We'll use fundamental identities and algebraic rules to simplify the expression. This process helps build a deeper understanding of how trigonometric functions relate to each other. By the end, you'll see how these identities can be proven systematically.
